use: Fictional IF-27 game asset appearance reference

left.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: individual orthographic reference image for a fictional IF-27 carbine game prop, to be used in multi-view image-to-3D modeling.
Primary request: Create ONE full LEFT SIDE elevation of one original modern military carbine, an IF-27, with its muzzle pointing LEFT and stock to the RIGHT. This is external appearance concept art for a video game, not a technical manufacturing diagram.
Subject/design: a coherent refined modern service carbine silhouette. Slim dark graphite metal upper/lower receiver, flat continuous top accessory rail, long slim octagonal ventilated handguard with one orderly row of elongated rounded rectangular openings, short exposed barrel with a compact dark muzzle tip, slightly curved removable dark-gray box magazine, angled textured charcoal polymer pistol grip with a true open trigger guard and visible trigger, a moderately extended adjustable polymer shoulder stock with a triangular side opening and black rubber butt pad. One small open-window reflex optic above the rear half of the receiver; hood must have an actual clear opening and subtly transparent neutral glass. No scope tube. Modest side controls. The left receiver face is predominantly closed with a small selector lever; no ejection opening on this left face. No sling, laser, flashlight, suppressor, foregrip, bipod, hands, arms, ammunition or loose components.
Proportions: compact believable service carbine; stock assembly roughly a quarter of overall length, receiver roughly a quarter, handguard roughly a third, exposed barrel and muzzle make up the remainder. Magazine visibly separate at its seam but seated in the receiver. Stock locked in a single intermediate extension. All components assembled in neutral state.
Style: polished realistic 3D game asset studio render, clearly modeled small bevels and distinct external parts, clean restrained detailing. Matte graphite metal subtly different from rough charcoal polymer and rubber. Very restrained edge wear, no dust or random scratches. Preserve readable middle-gray surfaces, not a black silhouette.
Composition: landscape 3:2 image, high resolution. STRICT orthographic left broadside, absolutely no perspective, no three-quarter angle, no top surface reveal. Gun perfectly horizontal, upright with magazine down. Entire gun including muzzle and butt fully visible. Center the gun and use about 88% of canvas width, generous clean margins. Plain pure white background, no floor plane, no cast shadow, no grid, no border, no labels, no watermark, no text.
Lighting: broad soft neutral studio light, even exposure, gentle cavity shading only. Crisp silhouette and highly legible shape. ONE gun ONE view only.

right.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: one clean orthographic multiview image-to-3D reference of the fictional IF-27 game prop.
Input image 1 is the approved LEFT SIDE master design. Re-render this EXACT SAME assembled gun from the requested new camera direction. Preserve its precise silhouette, all relative lengths, the identical long octagonal handguard with two prominent rows of six oblong side apertures, slim receiver, gray gently curved ribbed magazine, dark textured angled grip, triangular-open adjustable stock at identical extension, compact open-window reflex optic with a curved protective hood, short exposed barrel and compact slotted muzzle tip. Keep all dimensions, geometry, colors, material finishes, and component placements consistent. External video game prop visualization only, no internal cutaway or technical diagrams.
Use a landscape 3:2 canvas. Pure white background, soft neutral even light, no floor or cast shadow, no text, no labels, no border, no grid, no watermark, no hands, no loose components, no extra attachments. ONE complete gun, ONE view. Orthographic camera with absolutely no perspective or three-quarter turn. Gun upright, magazine down. Keep the whole object inside frame. Readable graphite midgray metal and dark polymer, restrained edge highlights.
Requested camera: strict RIGHT SIDE broadside elevation, directly opposite the source LEFT side. Muzzle points RIGHT, stock is LEFT. Full gun nearly fills width, with 5% white margins. This is the real opposite side of the same asset, NOT merely a mirrored image: show a modest rectangular ejection-port/dust-cover shape on the right upper receiver and small right-side control details, while preserving all major dimensions and components. The optic hood, magazine, stock and handguard must exactly match the source design when seen from the opposite side.

front.prompt: 为参考图中同一把 IF-27 虚构游戏道具步枪绘制一个新的正交产品展示视角。保留同一套深灰金属、黑灰聚合物、开放式小瞄具、弧形弹匣与伸缩枪托的外观设计。白色背景，柔和中性光，无人物、无情境、无动作、无文字、无网格、无尺寸、无拆解。3:2横幅，一个视角一个完整物体。相机位于物体的纵向前端，相机视线与枪管的长轴严格重合，是从前端向尾端观察的轴向正投影。画面中的物体必须呈细窄竖直轮廓：最上方是瞄具窗口，其下是护木端面和枪口圆形外观，下方垂直伸出的是弹匣窄面。整体轮廓的高度至少是宽度的三倍。枪身的长度在这个投影中完全重叠，不可画成横向长枪的侧视图，不可用三分之四视角。物体保持端正居中，整体高度占图像一半，左右留大片白底。只描绘外部可见表面。

back.camera_correction_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, a rear-view product render of an IF-27 fictional video-game prop. Image 2 is its approved side reference. Fix only the CAMERA ELEVATION of image 1: it currently looks slightly downward and exposes top rail surfaces and the distant muzzle above the sight. Replace that with an exactly level REAR ORTHOGRAPHIC elevation, zero pitch and zero yaw, camera centered on the longitudinal axis. The foreground rubber butt pad must remain a straight-on narrow vertical pad. The topmost visible part must be the open reflex-sight hood. The far barrel and muzzle must be occluded behind the stock/receiver, not stick up above the sight. No top faces or receding top rails should be visible. Keep the same design, stock size and extension, graphite/black materials, polymer grip, magazine and white background. Preserve the approximate overall width and height of the existing image 1 silhouette, centered in the same 3:2 canvas. One view only. No text, people, scene or extra parts. This is only external art reference, no internal mechanism.
